steps: Go to https://usertesting.com/be-a-user-tester and enter your email address to start the application.
Complete the applicant checklist: take the short practice test (unpaid) — on a computer no download is needed; on a phone, download the UserTesting app from the App Store or Google Play first.
Create your account with your name, username, password, and zip code, and link a verified PayPal account.
Wait for your first test to be manually reviewed and scored — only then can you take more tests.
Check your dashboard for available tests; every listing shows the exact amount you will be paid before you accept.
Complete the test: follow the tasks, speak your thoughts aloud clearly, and upload the recording.
Your payment is sent to PayPal, usually 14 days after you complete the test — track it under Test history.
timing: Payments sent to your linked verified PayPal account, usually 14 days after you complete a test; no minimum withdrawal threshold.
